# event spacetime

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventSpacetime`](gmeow-eventSpacetime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventSpacetime>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A spacetime slice of an event, expressed as a [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) that carries location, time interval or instant, pose, and optional velocity relative to an explicit reference frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)). Reuses [`LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) rather than minting a parallel 4D class. Multiple slices may coexist for the same event.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when an event needs full 4D placement — a location-plus-time slice carrying pose and optional velocity relative to an explicit reference frame — typically several slices tracing a moving occurrence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when a plain place ([`gmeow:eventLocation`](gmeow-eventLocation.md)) or a route ([`gmeow:eventTrajectory`](gmeow-eventTrajectory.md)) suffices, and never mint a parallel 4D class — reuse [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md), which already carries the frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) at one or more [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) individuals, each binding location, time, pose, and frame; multiple slices for one event coexist.

### Examples

- ex:flight [`gmeow:eventSpacetime`](gmeow-eventSpacetime.md) ex:slice0900, ex:slice1000.
